_readme:
User-facing strings for the next release. The release pipeline stamps versionName/versionCode, merges entries into app/src/main/assets/changelog.json, then resets entries to [].
If you don't see your entry, it means that it's been already released.
entries: There is a new map theme chooser! Check it out in the menu -> Map -> Choose Theme. Also, the default dark map has been tweaked to show small roads and paths better. If you liked the old one better, it's still available.
There is now a play/pause/off button for the weather radar on the main screen.
